title: Outpost configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/outpost/config.json. All fields are optional; an empty object uses defaults. Environment variables (PORT, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, BETTER_AUTH_URL, DB_FILE_NAME, MCP_RESOURCE_URL) override these values.

port.description: Port the HTTP server listens on.

secret.description: Better Auth signing secret. Set a long random value.

url.description: Public origin used for OAuth callbacks and discovery (the cloudflared URL).

mcpResourceUrl.description: Canonical MCP protected resource identifier, including the URL path.
